blocks.text:
After breakfast, your tour begins in La Candelaria, Bogotá's historic centre.

You will visit the Gold Museum. Its collection holds around 34,000 pre-Hispanic gold objects and more than 25,000 pre-Columbian artefacts.

The tour then continues to the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Museum. Here you can see works by Fernando Botero, the renowned Colombian painter, graphic artist and sculptor.

The final part of the tour takes you to Plaza de Bolívar. You will see the cathedral, Casa de Nariño, the presidential residence, Liévano Palace and the Palace of Justice.

After the tour, return to the hotel.

Private transport, an English-speaking guide, admission to the Gold Museum where possible, admission to the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Museum where possible, and a local medical assistance card are included.

Lunch and dinner are paid for separately.

The Gold Museum is closed on Mondays. The Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Foundation are closed on Tuesdays.
